description:
Inspect the React fiber tree and return a JSON representation of the component hierarchy.
Use when tracing the ancestry of a library component.
Returns a nested JSON tree of fiber nodes with name, tag, actualDuration, selfBaseDuration, and children.
Fails if the React DevTools hook is not present or no fiber roots have been committed yet.

device_id.description: Device logicalDeviceId from debugger-connect (iOS simulator UDID or Android logicalDeviceId).

filter.description: Regex string to filter component names

max_depth.description: Maximum tree depth to traverse. Default: 10. Must be greater than 0.

port.description: Metro port. Omit it to use this device's port (8081 by default). Ignored for Chromium, whose CDP port is in device_id. Range: 1 to 65535.

name: react-profiler-fiber-tree
